{{Quote|I do believe they think I am some sort of god.|C-3PO|<ref name="Episode VI">{{Film|VI}}</ref>}}
The '''Golden One''' was one of the many [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] gods; it had long been prophesied that he would one day appear to the Ewoks in person.

When [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and his companions with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] arrived on [[Endor/Legends|Endor]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], the Ewoks took the gold-plated [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] for the Golden One.

The Ewoks of [[Bright Tree Village/Legends|Bright Tree Village]], under the leadership of [[Logray/Legends|Logray]] and [[Chief/Legends|Chief]] [[Chirpa/Legends|Chirpa]], almost roasted [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], and [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] at a banquet in C-3PO's honor. Before the fires could be lit, Luke Skywalker used [[Telekinesis/Legends|telekinesis]] to lift the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] into the air (supposedly as a divine power of the Golden One) to scare their captors. As a result, the Ewoks freed the Rebels.

Later that night, C-3PO recounted the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] for the Ewoks, and translated his companions' pleas for help fighting the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. The Ewoks were convinced by [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa's]] plea to the Ewoks to join in the fight and defend their trees. The Rebels were adopted into the Ewok tribe, and won the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] thanks to Ewok assistance.

"The Golden One" was C-3PO's [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]] translation of the name of the Ewok god rather than the [[Ewokese/Legends|Ewokese]] name.
